serving_manifest.note: Serving artifacts are pinned there and resolved through ml/artifact_manifest.py, which fails closed on a missing entry or digest mismatch. This registry covers evidence only and must not list anything under ml/oof/ or duplicate a digest the serving manifest already records; entries for a serving-pinned path use "sha256_authority" instead. Enforced by scripts/verify_evidence_manifest.py.

note: See releases/artifacts/README.md. Every entry is currently `provisional`: the audit found the evidence itself invalid (C-01 leakage), so nothing here is frozen. Entries flip to `frozen` when regenerated from a clean rebuild. Pre-leak-fix eval_causal_stack_*.csv entries were removed on 2026-08-19; see reports/REMOVED_PRE_LEAK_FIX_EVIDENCE.md.
